fields.description: 64-byte header/config payload: first 0x40 bytes of the 0x44-byte SRAM header block. Treated by FUN_0801b85c as sixteen-bit words [0,0x20) feeding the header summation check; zeroed when verification fails. Internal byte semantics are not exposed by the stripped decomp.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b85c writes 0x44 bytes from the EWRAM config struct at _DAT_0801b8a8 to SRAM 0x0E000000 (file offset 0) via FUN_080236d4; the first 0x40 bytes are the word-summed payload and a mismatch zeroes bytes [0,0x40). FUN_0801b43c reads the same span back with FUN_08023688(stack_dst,0x0E000000,0x44).
fields.name: cfg_block_data

fields.description: 16-bit header verification word at struct/file offset 0x40. FUN_0801b85c compares it against the accumulated 16-bit word sum over the header; baseline holds 0x0000, consistent with an all-zero payload.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b85c accumulates sVar2 over the 0x44-byte header as 16-bit words and requires _DAT_0801b8a8[0x20] (struct byte offset 0x40 = file offset 64) to equal that sum, else it zeroes bytes [0,0x40) and reports failure via its indirect callback.
fields.name: header_checksum_word

fields.description: Trailing 16-bit word of the 0x44-byte header. Falls inside the FUN_0801b85c 0x22-word summation span (word index [0x21]) but is never directly compared; exact role unproven (baseline 0x0000). Live mutation is gbakit-verify-safe but may trip the in-game check.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b85c summation loop covers 0x22 sixteen-bit words (bytes [0,0x44)) from _DAT_0801b8a8 at SRAM 0x0E000000, so file offset 66 participates in header verification; only word [0x20] (offset 64) is used as the comparison target.
fields.name: verify_span_tail_word

fields.description: 480-byte extended save block backing the second SRAM transfer. File forensics plus the two transfer sizes prove its placement; internal structure is not exposed by the stripped decomp (all gameplay callers are indirect).
fields.evidence: FUN_0801b43c performs the second SRAM transfer FUN_08023688(dst_buf,_DAT_0801b490,0x1E0). Only file bytes [0,0x224) differ from the 0xFF erased fill and 0x44+0x1E0 == 0x224, proving _DAT_0801b490 is SRAM 0x0E000044, i.e. file offset 68.
fields.name: ext_block_data
